name: Return to Corporal Kaleb
summary: Krazek has mended the pot and added a second steam whistle, plus a new chopper in the base made to cut through leg bones. The pot now has to go back to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.

sections.title: A Better Pot
sections.body: Krazek has finished with the pot you brought in. It now has one more steam whistle and a new chopper set into the bottom, able to cut through leg bones. Krazek calls it a guaranteed cook-pleaser and expects the owner to be happy with it. It must go back to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.

sections.title: Back at the Camp
sections.body: Kaleb is delighted to see the pot working, because dinner can finally get started. Kaleb then hopes your time in Booty Bay went well, calling it a rough town, and passes along a rumor that goblins sometimes drag drunken sailors off to slave boats headed for parts unknown.

faq.answer: Corporal Kaleb is at the Rebel Camp, awaiting a cooking pot that Krazek in Booty Bay has been fixing.

faq.q: What did Krazek do to the pot?
faq.answer: Krazek repaired it, then fitted a second steam whistle and a fresh chopper in the base that slices through leg bones.

aliases: what led to return to corporal kaleb
